explanation.headline: Sulfamethoxazole and trimethoprim is not on FDA's shortage list; Corvale East has 26.9 days on hand and Corvale General has 29.5 days on hand

sentences.text: FDA's drug shortage list does not include sulfamethoxazole and trimethoprim as of 2026-10-21.
Corvale East holds 401 tablets of the 800 mg + 160 mg presentation with a daily use of 14.9 tablets, providing 26.9 days on hand.
Corvale General holds 469 tablets of the same presentation with a daily use of 15.9 tablets, providing 29.5 days on hand.
The top-ranked purchasing option is Amneal Pharmaceuticals LLC, whose plant Amneal Pharmaceuticals Private Limited received an NAI classification on 2024-07-19.
A secondary option is Amneal Pharmaceuticals of New York LLC, which operates the AMNEAL PHARMS NY plant.
A third option is Aurobindo Pharma Limited, though its label does not name a plant that can be placed in our records.

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.
